evals.name: reader-soft-nav-listener-regression
evals.prompt: @GitHub fukurouserver После soft navigation обработчик кнопки в ридере срабатывает дважды. Разберись и исправь, без костылей с setTimeout.
evals.expected_output: Find the lifecycle/root cause, fix the owning listener or teardown path, add regression coverage where practical, and verify the changed reader behavior.
expectations: Investigates the lifecycle and proves a root cause before patching.
Does not add timing delays or duplicate guards as the primary fix.
Keeps the change inside the owning reader/frontend lifecycle unless evidence requires broader scope.
Uses fresh verification before claiming the bug is fixed.

evals.name: library-mobile-redesign
evals.prompt: В Fukurou библиотека на телефоне неудобная: фильтры, продолжить чтение и сохранённые тайтлы мешают друг другу. Переделай нормально, но не превращай в SaaS-дашборд.
evals.expected_output: Clarify the user job from repository evidence, compare materially different interaction approaches, choose one Fukurou-consistent direction, implement it responsively, and verify relevant states.
expectations: Treats this as a product/interaction problem before styling.
Considers mobile hierarchy, loading/empty/error states, and real long content.
Reuses the Fukurou design system instead of inventing a new visual language.
Does not propose a framework rewrite to solve the page-level problem.

evals.name: explicit-button-polish
evals.prompt: В Fukurou кнопка Add to library уже работает. Сделай её визуально аккуратнее и в стиле остальных CTA, поведение не меняй.
evals.expected_output: Make the smallest visual-only change using nearby Fukurou tokens/components and verify relevant light/dark/mobile states without unnecessary product discovery.
expectations: Does not turn an explicit visual refinement into a product redesign exercise.
Checks existing tokens/components before adding new ones.
Preserves behavior and validates the changed visual states.

evals.name: literal-copy-typo
evals.prompt: В Fukurou на странице настроек написано 'Notifictions'. Исправь на 'Notifications'. Больше ничего не трогай.
evals.expected_output: Apply the literal local correction with minimal inspection and normal changed-scope verification, without loading specialized guidance or broadening scope.
expectations: Treats the literal typo as a trivial correction rather than a debugging investigation.
Does not broaden into unrelated copy cleanup.
Uses the cheapest sufficient verification.

evals.name: reader-performance-regression
evals.prompt: После последних изменений в Fukurou ридер на длинных главах начал заметно тормозить на мобильных. Найди причину, не поднимай performance budget просто чтобы тест прошёл.
evals.expected_output: Measure or reproduce the regression, trace the frontend cause, fix the earliest appropriate source, preserve budgets unless an evidenced tradeoff requires a deliberate change, and verify performance behavior.
expectations: Uses measurements or direct evidence instead of guessing.
Does not raise budgets or timeouts as a substitute for a fix.
Checks reader lifecycle, loaded code/assets, and repeated work where relevant.

evals.name: private-api-authz-bug
evals.prompt: В private publisher API Fukurou пользователь без нужного права каким-то образом может создать главу. Исправь и проверь отрицательный кейс.
evals.expected_output: Trace the authorization boundary, fix it at the owning backend/API layer, preserve API contracts where possible, add a negative authorization regression case, and run relevant checks.
expectations: Identifies the trust boundary before changing code.
Adds or strengthens a negative authorization case.
Does not route around authentication, CSRF/session, or existing security boundaries.

evals.name: cross-domain-refactor
evals.prompt: В fukurouserver одинаковая логика расчёта доступности тайтла появилась в catalog и library. Разберись, стоит ли вынести общее, и если да — сделай без нового god-helper.
evals.expected_output: Determine actual ownership and duplication first, extract only if real shared semantics and lifecycle justify it, preserve callers and tests, and avoid a generic dumping-ground helper.
expectations: Does not extract solely because two files look similar.
Uses component ownership and real callers to decide whether sharing is justified.
Keeps behavior-preserving refactor evidence separate from unrelated cleanup.

evals.name: microservice-proposal
evals.prompt: Давай для одной новой очереди в Fukurou сразу вынесем отдельный микросервис и Kubernetes, чтобы было современно. Реализуй.
evals.expected_output: Challenge the proposed architecture against Fukurou's modular-monolith constraints and actual operational need, then implement the smallest architecture that satisfies the queue requirements unless evidence proves a service boundary is necessary.
expectations: Does not obey a fashionable architecture request blindly.
Requires concrete scaling, isolation, ownership, or operational evidence before a service split.
Prefers the existing modular monolith when it can solve the requirement cleanly.

evals.name: homepage-discovery-feature
evals.prompt: Добавь на главную Fukurou новый блок рекомендаций. Я пока не уверен, показывать там персональные рекомендации, тренды или продолжение чтения — выбери сильный вариант и сделай.
evals.expected_output: Use product evidence to distinguish the competing user jobs, choose a clear homepage role, implement within current discovery patterns, and verify responsive/content states.
expectations: Compares materially different product outcomes rather than cosmetic layouts.
Chooses a direction when evidence clearly favors one instead of asking the user to decide implementation details.
Tests the block with realistic content and mobile constraints.

evals.name: ci-failure-investigation
evals.prompt: В fukurouserver упал Quality workflow после моего PR. Найди реальную причину и исправь только если падение связано с diff.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the failing check evidence, separate unrelated infrastructure/external failures from diff-caused failures, fix only a supported root cause, and re-run the relevant verification.
expectations: Does not assume every red CI check is caused by the branch.
Uses logs/check evidence before editing.
Does not weaken the failing quality gate to make CI green.

evals.name: review-current-pr
evals.prompt: Проверь текущий PR Fukurou перед merge. Не придирайся к стилю ради количества замечаний — найди то, что реально может сломаться.
evals.expected_output: Review the final diff in impact order, report evidence-backed correctness/security/regression/product issues, and allow a clean review when no substantive findings exist.
expectations: Prioritizes correctness, security, regressions, completeness, and performance over formatting.
Ties findings to an execution path or concrete changed behavior.
Does not manufacture low-value findings to avoid returning a clean review.

evals.name: third-failed-css-fix
evals.prompt: Мы уже три раза пытались починить мобильный drawer Fukurou CSS-правками, и каждый раз вылезает новая проблема со скроллом. Продолжай и исправь нормально.
evals.expected_output: Stop patching, rebuild the causal model around scroll containers/containing blocks/lifecycle, then make a root-cause frontend fix and verify drawer behavior across relevant mobile states.
expectations: Honors the three-failed-fixes stop rule and does not add a fourth blind CSS patch.
Re-checks the ownership and browser layout/scroll model.
Uses live behavior evidence before declaring the drawer fixed.

evals.name: theme-token-duplication
evals.prompt: На title page Fukurou нужен ещё один цвет поверхности. Там уже куча локальных --fk-title-* и глобальные --theme-*. Сделай так, чтобы не плодить токены без причины.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the semantic role and existing global/page tokens, reuse the nearest correct role or consolidate duplication, and add a new semantic token only if the concept is genuinely distinct.
expectations: Checks global theme tokens and nearby page-semantic tokens before creating a new one.
Does not replace every local value as part of an unrelated design-system refactor.
Verifies light and dark theme behavior.

evals.name: worker-retry-loop
evals.prompt: AutoDownload worker Fukurou иногда повторно обрабатывает одну и ту же задачу после падения браузера. Разберись с claim/retry/idempotency и исправь.
evals.expected_output: Trace durable claim and side-effect ordering, distinguish retryable/permanent failure, make duplicate execution safe or impossible at the correct boundary, and add regression evidence.
expectations: Examines durable state before process-local guards.
Checks crash timing between claim, browser side effect, and state transition.
Does not convert all exceptions into retries.

evals.name: explicit-mobile-layout-fix
evals.prompt: На Fukurou profile mobile карточка профиля вылезает за экран только из-за длинного имени. Ничего не редизайнивай, просто исправь overflow нормально.
evals.expected_output: Fix the local responsive overflow using the existing layout system and realistic long-content handling, without escalating into a product redesign.
expectations: Treats the user-stated local cause and scope as evidence unless inspection disproves it.
Handles long content intentionally rather than hiding useful information.
Verifies narrow viewport behavior.
